items.name: utils
items.title: cn
items.description: clsx + tailwind-merge helper used by every Chamuka component.

items.name: classes
items.title: shared classes
items.description: Focus ring and popup surfaces shared by Chamuka components.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Primary action control. Daybreak v2: ember fill with ink text (4.8:1), mono 13px uppercase, 2px radius, no shadow. Secondary/outline use a hairline edge.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: IconButton
items.description: Square icon-only button. Requires a visible-name `label`.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Text link: foreground text with a 1px underline that turns ember on hover.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text field.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text field.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label + control + help + error. Wires aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Boolean choice with a Daybreak check indicator.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off setting.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: Single choice from a short list.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Popup list of options.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable list of options.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal task over the page. DialogContent includes the overlay.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Non-modal floating panel.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu
items.description: Action menu from a button. Wraps UI SDK Menu behind the Chamuka names.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short hint on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: One panel visible at a time. TabsTrigger/TabsContent alias UI SDK TabsTab/TabsPanel.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable sections. defaultValue accepts a string or string[].

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Transient notification. useToast().toast({ title, description, variant }).

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline status message. Hairline edge on a surface fill; status variants add an 8px signal dot, danger turns the edge ember. No tinted fills or side bars.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Surface grouping for forms and summaries. 1px hairline edge, 4px radius, no shadow; CardTitle is condensed uppercase display.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small mono uppercase label with a 1px edge and 2px radius. Status variants add an 8px signal dot.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Image with initials fallback.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical rule.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Indeterminate loading indicator.

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: Flex stack with gap variants.

items.name: container
items.title: Container
items.description: Centered max-width wrapper.

items.name: theme-provider
items.title: ThemeProvider
items.description: Sets data-theme (and .dark/.light) on a wrapper so Daybreak v2 roles resolve. Defaults to system; dark when there is no preference.
